description: Rust command with no configured event staging authority, followed by a fresh query
qualification: local normal combined-source node with ephemeral demo trust
observations: An initial fresh query returned an absent key and zero aggregate.
The update request under a configuration with no event staging installation returned HTTP 409 with an aborted disposition, a validated abort fence and no effect IDs.
A subsequent fresh query returned zero with the key still absent. Namespace inspection showed one command record, zero encoded state bytes and zero pending effects.
The normal node was reaped after clean shutdown and physically retired state and effect owners.
limitations: The abort observation alone does not identify the precise internal failure or prove the guest reached its event-staging call.
This does not establish a successful state and event commit, declared business rejection, conflict, recovery, other guests, production trust, hosted CI or packaged distribution.
The normal node was built from a verified local combined-source snapshot containing unmerged work. The companion Rust query receipt records the captured authoring inputs and component.
